{Pikachu} crackles in {Front} of the {Jungle}, cheeks sparking, and fires a Thunderbolt at a *stone* the size of a sofa. {James Bond} strolls {Inside} the {Beach} in his tuxedo and finds the sand has grown **thorns**. {Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Lagoon}, lifts a relic off its pedestal and springs an ancient trap: a stone *dragon* wakes and roars into a giant *ear* carved in the wall. {Lara Croft} climbs down into the {Basement} of the {Tower} expecting ancient traps, and the floor tilts as dumplings the size of boulders roll at her. {Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Museum}, legs whirring, and hovers above a *king* paddling a *dugout canoe* up the stairs in perfect balance. {Yoshi} pops into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa}, and his long tongue snatches the name tag off each *woman* in the hot pool. {James Bond} sits in the {Basement} of the {Museum} on a broken *stepladder*, after the first failed escape of his career, as *water drops* plip onto his tuxedo. {Mario} leaps {Inside} the {Jungle} and head-butts a block hidden in the *grass*, but instead of a coin, a vine begins **to sprout** from it. {Casper} floats down the chimney and through the wall into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, trailing a cloud of *soot*. {Frodo} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} after a very long walk, and his bare hairy feet sink into a steaming heap of **manure**. {Lara Croft} flips {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} carrying a relic from a lost tomb, a cracked tragic mask. {Kermit} flails in {Front} of the {Casino} with his clipboard as the big finale falls apart, so he spears a lump of *soil* on a *skewer* and holds it up like a prop planet. "Yaaay! {Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Beach} on a vine and hears a huge *mouth* up in the clouds begin **to cry**. He talks to animals, so he asks the gulls, and they say the *sky god* has lost his kite. {Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and lands between two cooks locked in a *quarrel*, tugging a *melon* back and forth. {James Bond} wobbles into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} on *stilts*, wearing Q's latest cufflink, which does one thing: it straightens. {Batman} sets off {Inside} the {Spa} on foot, because his grappling hook has jammed and his cape won't glide. {Walter White} climbs down to the {Basement} of the {Hangar} with a ruler and a spirit level, where a *king* is trying to stand a *tree* up straight. It leans **crooked**, and Walter, proud of his precise science, is appalled. He titrates a straightening solution and pours it on, but the *tree* bends worse and the *king* leans **crooked** in sympathy, as do Walter's glasses.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Basement} of the {Jungle} temple exactly when he means to and finds a tiny *tree* growing from a *gong*. He taps the *gong* with his staff and mutters a spell, and one leafy **stalk** shoots up and wiggles. "You shall not pass!" he snaps at it, but the **stalk** passes him anyway, dancing the cha-cha round his pointy hat.

{Cookie Monster} stampedes into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and skids to the lip of a *cliff*, where a lone **toilet** sits with a *rulebook* chained to it. "Me want cookie!" he bellows, devouring the *rulebook*, which goes on shouting its rules through his crumbs. The chain goes next, then the seat, and the **toilet** flushes in disgust and splashes his blue fur.

The {Joker} sneaks {Inside} the {Warehouse}, where a *king* wants **to carve** a noble statue from jade. Chips fly, and together they **carve** the king's proud face with a huge grin, green hair and all, as the Joker squirts his flower in delight.

{James Bond} stands unruffled in {Front} of the {Beach} hut in his tuxedo when a cocky gull lands on a *small table*. {Yoshi} pops up in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, swallows a wet clay pot and lays it as a dull grey egg in a *sprouting field*, which lifts it up on green shoots. Wild *animal tracks* stamp all over it, a fox, a hen, a deer, and each print gleams with shining **glaze**. He rolls it till it shines, then licks the animals' paws to **glaze** them too.

{Kermit} hops in {Front} of the {Pool}, clipboard flailing, and finds a *cave* where the next act should be. A *crouching man* beckons him through, and it opens into a huge glittering **grotto** full of stalactites and glowing fish. "Yaaay!" Kermit squeals, and his voice rings round and round, so he strums the banjo and announces tonight's show live from the **grotto**.

{Lara Croft} swings down into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, where an ancient treasure lies scattered across the floor. She solves the puzzle on the wall, calls an *assembly* and taps an old *cane* three times, and every coin rolls towards her. {Sherlock} crash-lands in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} on a runaway *cart*, gripping the **carriage handrail** with one hand and his magnifying glass with the other. {Pikachu} sparks in {Front} of the {Lake} house and finds the *moon* resting on a stone *plinth* like an egg. It cracks a little, and there floats a tiny curled-up **embryo** with yellow ears. {Sherlock} lies on the grass in {Front} of the {Funfair}, bored out of his mind, with a *skewer* of candy floss stuck to his coat. {Charlie Brown} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} with his kite, where a *beacon* glows over a mountain of *silk thread*. {Casper} drifts into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, meaning to rescue a *trapped man* dangling from the fingers of a huge *helping hand*. {Kermit} hops in {Front} of the {Hangar} clutching a sack of gold and *rice husk*, overcome by the show's success, and his *standing heart* beams green. {Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Museum}, belly wobbling, because he knows exactly what **to expect**: an egg. {Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Waiting Room}, where a *weeping willow* has grown through the floor and eaten his kite. {Sherlock} stands in {Front} of the {Swan Pond} and examines a leaking *treasure chest* with his magnifying glass. {James Bond} wades into the flooded {Basement} of the {Stadium} without wetting his tuxedo. {Walter White} marches {Inside} the {Funfair} and a *bug* with a *tattoo* whines in his ear: a **mosquito**. It bites him, and he pauses, glasses glinting. {Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} and lands on a giant *stone* dragged in from the *roadside*, which turns out to be a weighing **scale** with a wild dial. {Naruto} crashes into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} and lands in a heap of *wormwood*, while a naughty *child* waves a match at it. Whoosh! {Charlie Brown} trudges in {Front} of the {Warehouse}, where a *pheasant* is pecking at his new kite. {Batman} drops silently into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, cape spread, and lifts a *lid* off a barrel with a gadget from his belt. {Casper} floats out of the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, onto a green *hillside* in central China, and waves a shy hello to a hiker. {Kermit} pops out of the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room}, arms flailing, ready to host. "And now, it's time **to present**!" he squeals, carrying a *side dish* with a big *price tag* on it. {Yoshi} flutters {Inside} the {Mint}, tongue out, and slurps up a great mouthful of *soil*. {James Bond} dives into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, tuxedo spotless, and lands in a *bargain bin* brimming with *water drops*. {James Bond} stands in {Front} of the {Cat Café} in his tuxedo, grilling on a *barbecue* made of *stone*, when Q's remote goes off. The {Joker} struts in {Front} of the {Hangar} in his purple suit, wearing a *badge* the size of a dinner plate. {Mario} leaps in {Front} of the {Beach} hut and head-butts a block, but instead of a coin out flies a grain of *rice*, straight into his *eye*. {Lara Croft} climbs {Inside} the {Inn} at night, searching for a lost tomb's entrance, and trips on a *stone* that glows green. A *will-o'-the-wisp* floats out and leads her past spikes. {Walter White} marches {Inside} the {Funfair} under grey *rain* with a rack of beakers and gives his class a lesson in flame tests. {Yoshi} sits in {Front} of the {Museum} beside a *road*, where a *coat stand* in spectacles lectures every driver about comma rules, so **pedantic** it corrects the clouds. {Darth Vader} stalks out of the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, breathing loudly and holding up a lit *beacon*, because his favourite droid has rusted. {Homer} waddles {Inside} the {Pool}, half asleep, and sees a *bug* with long *whiskers* and frosted pink wings. {Yoshi} pops out of the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, where a *busy mother* is juggling seedlings and a *tumbling baby*. {Homer} waddles into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and spots a doughnut stuck on a high shelf. {Kermit} staggers {Inside} the {Hangar}, flailing, the stage manager of a show with no crew, and a heavy *workbench* for the set lands on his head. {Kermit} flails in {Front} of the {Hut} with a *lidded dish* of dumplings for the cast's dinner, but the lid is stuck. He grabs a *stone* and starts **to knock** on it: knock, knock, KNOCK! {Chewbacca} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} beside an *emperor* with *feathers* in his hair. {Cookie Monster} thunders {Inside} the {Tower}, dragging a hollowed-out *tree* as long as a canoe, and declares it a *trough* for cookies. {Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Waiting Room} and lands on a marble statue with a *bald head*, which is reading a *page* of instructions. {Shrek} stands in {Front} of a hut in the {Dunes}, roasting onions and swamp weed on smoking *embers*, and a **fragrance** curls out across the desert.
